description: X7 (an exact 7-bit E4M3 code) decoded in the MXFP8 decode GEMM's tile load, against the production decode GEMM: bit-exact outputs at 1-16 rows and per-call times on cold and L2-warm weights, on real DS4.1-1017 projections (TP4 rank slices) and candidate 9's image (next-9). A timing bundle: its exit status is the verdict (0 only when every output matched).
